info.title: WorkBuddy Buddy Control Plane API
info.summary: Versioned Edge reporting and public Office viewing contract.
info.description:
Milestone 0 contract for the WorkBuddy Buddy Control Plane.

Edge reports are authenticated, signed, and fenced by `instance_id`, a
compare-and-swap-linked `boot_id`, and the per-boot `sequence`. A new boot is
accepted only when its required `previous_boot_id` names the server's current
boot (or is null for the first boot). State events and heartbeats share the
same strictly increasing, per-boot sequence space.

The server assigns one authoritative `server_received_at` to every accepted report. Client
`observed_at` is diagnostic metadata only and MUST NOT determine leases,
grace periods, activity intervals, rankings, or awards. Likewise,
`idle_stage` is never accepted as a scoring input: public idle stages are
derived by the server from continuous eligible-idle time.

Protocol v1 publishes `current_protocol = 1` and
`min_supported_protocol = 1`; it does not imply or accept a fictional v0.
When protocol N is introduced, the same response fields can advertise the
N/N-1 compatibility window. Unsupported versions receive a structured `426`
response so an Edge can present an actionable upgrade message without
discarding its local desktop-pet state.

tags.name: Edge
tags.description: Signed, idempotent reporting by enrolled Agent instances.

tags.name: Onboarding
tags.description: Anonymous first-run Office creation and short-lived capability pairing. Pairing codes and status tokens are bearer capabilities: clients must redact them from logs, never send them as public Office tokens, and honor `private, no-store` responses.

tags.name: Public Office
tags.description:
Unauthenticated, read-only views. Live `agents` are filtered by
`presence_visible`; leaderboard entries and Daily Awards are filtered
independently by `stats_opt_in`. Poster consent is not part of this API
projection. No email address, human name, device secret, private history, or
raw WorkBuddy event is exposed.

post.summary: Report a bounded batch of derived state events.
post.description:
Durably and atomically accepts an ordered, contiguous batch of
derived Edge events from one boot's monotonic sequence space. State
transitions and heartbeats consume that same space. No
prefix of a rejected batch is applied. While that boot remains current,
replaying an entire batch with the same `instance_id`, accepted boot
generation, sequence range, and canonical payload returns the same
acknowledgement without side effects. A replay from a fenced boot always
returns `stale_boot` instead. Reusing any sequence with different canonical
content is a conflict. A gap or partially overlapping replay is also a
conflict; callers recover from the `expected_sequence` in the Problem response
rather than skipping ahead.

A new boot starts at sequence 1 and its first event MUST be a complete
`state_transition` snapshot. Its required `previous_boot_id` is null only for
the first boot; otherwise it MUST exactly match the server's current boot.
This compare-and-swap establishes the next fencing generation without allowing
a delayed, previously unseen old boot to reverse-fence the current one. A
mismatch or report from a fenced boot is rejected and MUST NOT update current
presence, renew a lease, restart a grace period, or contribute to scoring.

Only privacy-safe derived state may be sent. Prompt text, messages, tool
arguments, filesystem paths, session contents, email bodies, OAuth
tokens, raw spool records, and client-computed `idle_stage` are outside
this contract.

post.summary: Renew presence with a sequenced heartbeat.
post.description:
Accepts an Edge report envelope containing exactly one `heartbeat`
event for the already-established current boot. A heartbeat cannot establish
a new boot: sequence 1 of every new boot is sent to the batch endpoint as a
complete state snapshot. Heartbeats consume the same monotonic sequence space
as state transitions; they are not an independent counter. Replaying the same
canonical heartbeat returns the same acknowledgement without renewing the
lease twice. A gap, a partial overlap, a multi-event envelope, or a
non-heartbeat event is rejected.

A heartbeat may renew an active lease, but it cannot backfill an expired
lease or recover idle time lost while offline. Lease calculations begin
from the server's `server_received_at`, never from `observed_at` or `sent_at`.
A heartbeat from a fenced boot is incapable of changing presence.

post.summary: Create a private Office and issue one pairing.
post.description: Atomically creates a private, unlisted Office with one owner, Lobby, logical Agent, mounted pet, weekday schedule, and short-lived Edge pairing. The raw `pairing_code`, `status_token`, and public Office capability are returned only once and are stored by the server only as hashes. This anonymous convenience endpoint is IP-rate-limited.

get.summary: Read the status of one short-lived pairing.
get.description: Returns only `pending`, `claimed`, or `expired` for the supplied status capability. The 43-character status token is distinct from both the Edge pairing code and the public Office token. Unknown capabilities return `404` without revealing Office existence.

post.summary: Claim a pairing with an Ed25519 device key.
post.description: Consumes a pending pairing and enrolls one active Agent instance with the supplied raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key. The key is encoded as canonical padded standard Base64. A replay using the same pairing and public key returns the exact same enrollment result; a different key returns `409`. Expired pairings return `410`. The private key never leaves WorkBuddy.

get.description:
Returns a point-in-time public projection and its monotonic
`office_revision`. The revision is the same cursor space used by the SSE
endpoint, allowing a client to fetch this snapshot and then request
events strictly after it. Withdrawing any consent increments that revision
and the next snapshot immediately removes the affected Mount from the
corresponding projection.

The `agents` list requires `presence_visible`; leaderboard entries and Daily
Awards separately require `stats_opt_in`. One flag never substitutes for the
other. If a completed Award's immutable winner withdraws `stats_opt_in`, the
stored Award is not reassigned but the public `daily_award` projection becomes
null. `office.local_date` and `leaderboard.office_local_date` identify the
current scoring office-day and MUST be equal; a cross-midnight schedule window
belongs to the local date on which that window started.

`idle_stage`, rankings, and awards in this projection are server-derived. The
endpoint never returns the client-reported idle stage or an Edge's wall-clock
calculation.

Missing, expired, rotated, and revoked public view tokens deliberately
use the same not-found response to avoid leaking Office existence.

get.summary: Stream consent-filtered Office revisions over SSE.
get.description:
Opens a Server-Sent Events stream in the same monotonic revision space
as the snapshot endpoint. Clients should first fetch a snapshot and
reconnect with that `office_revision` as `Last-Event-ID` or
`after_revision`. If both cursors are supplied they MUST be equal. A cursor
above the current Office revision is invalid and returns `400`; a cursor below
the server's explicit minimum replay cursor returns `409 revision_gap`, even
when no replay events remain retained.

A replayable update uses `event: office.snapshot`, sets `id` to the new
decimal `office_revision`, and carries one
`public-office-snapshot.v1` JSON document in `data`. Duplicate revisions
are idempotent and clients MUST ignore them. Comment frames may be used
as transport keepalives and do not advance the revision.

If the requested revision is older than the retained replay window, the
server returns `409 application/problem+json` before opening the stream.
If a gap is discovered after streaming has begun, the server sends an
`event: resync.required` control event and closes the connection; the
client then obtains a fresh snapshot.

Every emitted snapshot re-applies independent consent filters: `agents` by
`presence_visible`, leaderboard and Daily Award data by `stats_opt_in`.
Withdrawing a flag advances `office_revision`, so the next SSE projection
removes the affected data immediately. `poster_opt_in` is evaluated only when
generating a new share asset and never broadens either underlying consent. No
SSE event exposes raw Edge reports.

200.description:
SSE stream. Each `office.snapshot` data value conforms to
`./schemas/public-office-snapshot.v1.schema.json`.

resyncRequired.summary: Replay gap discovered after the stream opened.

400.description: Cursor is malformed or the two supplied cursors disagree.

409.description:
The requested cursor is outside the short-term replay window. The
Problem response identifies `revision_gap`; the client must fetch a
new snapshot instead of guessing or skipping revisions.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description:
Optional request-attempt correlation key. Edge event idempotency does
not depend on this header; it is always enforced by
`instance_id + accepted boot generation + sequence`.

PublicViewToken.name: public_view_token
PublicViewToken.description:
High-entropy, rotatable read-only capability. It is distinct from an
Office's public name and from invite tokens. Implementations store only
its hash and redact the raw value from logs and error telemetry.

PairingStatusToken.name: status_token
PairingStatusToken.description: A 256-bit status capability encoded as exactly 43 unpadded Base64url characters. It authorizes only polling this pairing and must not be logged or confused with the Edge pairing code or public Office token.

LastEventId.name: Last-Event-ID
LastEventId.description:
Last fully applied decimal `office_revision`. The stream resumes with
the first retained revision greater than this value.

AfterRevision.name: after_revision
AfterRevision.description:
Browser-friendly alternative to `Last-Event-ID`. When both are present,
they must have the same value.

CurrentProtocol.description:
Current protocol version produced by this server (N). For this v1
contract the value is `1`.

MinSupportedProtocol.description:
Oldest protocol accepted by this server. For this initial v1 contract
the value is `1`; once N is introduced it may become N-1.

SupportedProtocols.description:
Comma-separated protocol versions accepted during the current
compatibility window, ordered newest first; for example, `2, 1`.

UpgradeLink.description: HTTPS URL for the supported Edge release or upgrade guide.

ServerReceivedAt.description:
RFC 3339 server timestamp at which the report entered the authoritative
ingestion boundary. The same report-level value is present in the
acknowledgement body and applies to every event accepted atomically in that
report.

PrivateNoStore.description: Prevents intermediaries from retaining capability-token views.

NoReferrer.description: Prevents a capability-bearing URL from being disclosed as a referrer.

NoSniff.description: Prevents content-type sniffing on capability responses.

OfficeRevisionEtag.description: Strong ETag derived from the Office projection revision.

public_key.description: Canonical standard Base64 encoding of exactly 32 raw Ed25519 public-key bytes.

RevisionCursor.description:
Monotonic non-negative integer that remains exactly representable by
JavaScript clients. Zero means no Office revision has yet been applied.

OnboardingOfficeCreated.description: Private Office topology created and one five-minute pairing issued.

OnboardingPairingStatus.description: Current state of the pairing capability.

EdgeEnrollmentClaimed.description: The device credential was enrolled, or this is an idempotent replay using the same pairing and public key.

OnboardingBadRequest.description: The request is malformed, contains extra or missing fields, or violates an onboarding input boundary.

OnboardingPairingNotFound.description: The status or pairing capability is unknown.

OnboardingPairingConflict.description: The pairing has already been claimed by a different public key.

OnboardingPairingExpired.description: The pending pairing has passed its server-authored expiration.

OnboardingRateLimited.description: The per-IP onboarding window or pairing attempt budget is exhausted.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds until this request may be retried.

OnboardingInternalError.description: The Control Plane could not complete onboarding.

EdgeReportAccepted.description: The report was durably accepted, or was an exact replay from the still-current boot whose original acknowledgement is returned without side effects. A replay from a fenced boot, sequence gaps, partial overlaps, and same-sequence different-content conflicts use a `409` Problem response. Presence is anchored to the authoritative `server_received_at` in the acknowledgement; `idle_stage` remains server-derived.

BadEdgeReport.description: Malformed envelope, invalid canonical form, or invalid sequence layout.

UnauthenticatedEdge.description: Device key is unknown or revoked, or the signature is invalid.

EdgeFenceConflict.description:
The report uses a fenced boot, fails the `previous_boot_id`
compare-and-swap, reuses a sequence with different content, starts after an
unexplained sequence gap, or conflicts with the active reporting instance.
Retrying unchanged content is safe; changing `observed_at`, `sent_at`, or
signature does not make a conflicting sequence acceptable.

EdgeBatchTooLarge.description: The bounded event count or encoded request size is exceeded.

UnprocessableEdgeReport.description:
The envelope is structurally valid but violates non-conflict protocol
semantics, for example `first_sequence` not matching the first event, a new
boot whose first event is not a state snapshot, or a display/activity
combination forbidden by the declared protocol version. Intra-batch gaps and
overlaps are sequence conflicts and use `409`, not `422`.

UnsupportedProtocol.description:
The Edge protocol is older than `X-Min-Supported-Protocol` or newer than
the server's current protocol. The local desktop pet must keep running;
only Control Plane reporting is unavailable until compatibility is
restored.

PublicOfficeNotFound.description: Public Office capability is unknown, expired, rotated, or revoked.

EdgeRateLimited.description: The signed Edge report was not processed because this enrolled device or source exceeded its reporting budget. No event, lease, receipt, sequence, or scoring state is advanced.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds until this Edge should retry the unchanged report.
Seconds until the caller should retry.

TemporarilyUnavailable.description: Control Plane is temporarily unable to serve the request.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the caller should retry.
